correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed the complete eight-state continuous-time generator for bit-order n3n2n1: injection into empty site 1 at 1/2, exit site 3 at 1/6, right-hop rate 1, and each occupied donor site 2 or 3 resetting independently to vacant site 1 at rate rho. Independently verified the provided eight polynomial stationary weights sum to 2(3rho+5)(6rho^2+44rho+55), solve all eight balance equations Q^T w=0, and yield C13=3F/H^2, F=54rho^4+18rho^3-231rho^2-125rho+125. Descartes signs +,+,-,-,+ give at most two positive roots; opposite signs at rho=0,1,3 give exactly two simple roots near 0.532486743 and 2.043310541. Exact adjacent polynomials prove C12,C23<0 for rho>=1. Irreducibility of finite chain for alpha,beta>0 and continuity of stationary law prove at least two crossings after small boundary-rate changes; no claim of exactly two for all nearby rates or long chains.
